newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Eng Kong offers 20 mln shares at S$0.56 in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Eng Kong offers 20 mln shares at S$0.56 in IPO.

text.p: Shipping container logistics group Eng Kong Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was offering 20 million shares at Singapore $0.56 each in an initial public offer (IPO).
A company statement said five million shares will be placed out while 15 million will be offered to the public.
The company, which is seeking a listing on the second board, has priced its shares at a historical price earnings ratio of 12.2 times.
The group made a net profit of S$3.2 million for the financial year ended June 30 1996. For the first half ended December 31 1996, profit was at S$2.45 million.

Net proceeds of S$9.8 million raised from the IPO will be used to buy equipment and for working capital for its operations in Hong Kong, Malaysia, Thailand and Singapore. The offer is lead managed by DBS Bank. It will close on March 17 and trading will start on March 19.
